text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Agnes Tachyon's
Debut Race.

choice_data_list: Are you nervous, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was lamenting the fact that the lab ran out of black tea.
How careless of me to forget to restock.
choice_data_list: (That has nothing to do with the debut race...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, while the races are going on is fine, just buy me some tea.
Sabaragamuwa or Keemun would be lovely.
choice_data_list: There's no way I could miss your race—
There's no way I could miss your race—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, look at the time.
I really must be going.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you have neither, Assam will do.
Bring it to the lab.
Saying that, Agnes Tachyon made a dashing exit from the waiting room.
